title: How to Add a Catalog to WhatsApp Business (2026 Steps)
description: How to add a catalog to WhatsApp Business on Android and iPhone, step by step. What every product needs, what happens after you save, and how to share it.
h1: How to Add a Catalog to WhatsApp Business: Step by Step for Android and iPhone
answer: To add a catalog to WhatsApp Business, open the Tools tab, tap Catalog, then Add new item. Add photos, a product name and the country of origin, then tap Save. WhatsApp checks each item first. Customers see it on your business profile once it is approved. The catalogue is only in the WhatsApp Business app, not the normal WhatsApp app.
waText: Hi OneCatalog, I want help adding a catalog to WhatsApp Business.

sections.h2: Before you add a catalog to WhatsApp Business

blocks.p: The catalogue is a feature of the WhatsApp Business app. It shows on your business profile, where customers can browse it. Get these ready for each product before you start:

table.caption: What each WhatsApp catalogue item needs
head: Detail
Required?
Tip
rows: Yes, and it must be unique
Add the colour or size, like "Teak sofa, 3-seater"
You can add up to 10 photos or videos. Videos up to 50 MB.
Where the product was made. WhatsApp asks on every item.
WhatsApp says prices are only available in some countries
Size, material and what is included
A link to the product on your website, if you have one
Your own code, so you know the item when a customer asks

sections.h2: How to add a product on Android

ol: Tap **Add photos and videos**. Tap **Gallery** to pick photos, or **Camera** to take new ones.
Tap **Country of origin**, choose the country and tap **Save**.
Add any optional details, like price or description.

blocks.alt: Add new item screen in the WhatsApp Business catalogue on Android
blocks.capture: Android. Tools > Catalog > Add new item, with photos added and the name, country of origin and price fields visible.

sections.h2: How to add a product on iPhone

ol: Tap **Add new item**, then **Add photos and videos**.
Tap **Photo & video library**, pick your photos and tap **Next**. Or tap **Camera** to take new ones.
Tap **Country of origin**, choose the country and tap **Save**.

blocks.alt: Add new item screen in the WhatsApp Business catalogue on iPhone
blocks.capture: iPhone. Tools > Catalog > Add new item, with photos added and the name and country of origin fields visible.

blocks.p: WhatsApp checks every photo, video and item against its rules. Customers see the item only after it is approved, and WhatsApp adds it to your catalogue on its own. If WhatsApp rejects it, you see a red exclamation mark next to the photo.

**How to check it worked:** open your catalogue from a family member's phone. Approved items show. Items still waiting or rejected don't. Our [catalog approval time guide](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-approval-time) explains the review, and our guide on [why WhatsApp rejects catalog items](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-rejected) shows how to appeal.

blocks.callout: **What we see with real shops:** the first catalogue most owners make is 5 or 6 items, added on the day they install WhatsApp Business, then left alone. Customers notice old stock fast. Add a few new items every week, and hide sold-out ones instead of deleting them.

blocks.p: Once you have more than 10 or 15 products, group them, like "Sofas" and "Beds". WhatsApp calls these collections. Our guide to [WhatsApp catalogue categories](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-categories) shows how to make them.

The quickest way is from a customer's chat: tap the attach icon, then **Catalog**, then **Send catalog**. You can also share the link to your status, or copy it. Our guide on [how to share your WhatsApp catalog link](/guides/how-to-share-whatsapp-catalog-link) has every option for Android and iPhone.

**Hide** an item when it is out of stock. It stays in your catalogue, but customers don't see it. On Android, open the item, tap the menu and **Hide**. On iPhone, open the item, tap **Edit**, turn on **Hide this item** and tap **Save**. WhatsApp says hiding may not be on every phone yet.
**Delete** an item you will never sell again. On Android, open the item, tap the menu and **Delete**. On iPhone, swipe left on the item in your catalogue and tap **Delete**.

sections.h2: Can I add a catalog in the normal WhatsApp app?

blocks.p: No. The catalogue is only in the WhatsApp Business app. It is free to download from the Play Store or App Store. Customers can view your catalogue from the normal WhatsApp app.

sections.h2: Can I add many products at once?

blocks.p: Not in the app. It adds products one at a time. To upload a spreadsheet of products, use Meta Commerce Manager and connect that catalogue to WhatsApp. Our [bulk upload guide](/guides/whatsapp-catalog-bulk-upload) explains how.

Adding 50 products one by one takes a long evening. You can send us your photos and price list on WhatsApp instead.
